description: Realised and unrealised profit and loss of a wallet's DEX trading (FIFO, in ADA and USD), win rate (percent), trade count, volume (ADA) and the tokens that contributed most. Only covers swaps since `coverageFrom`. Slower than other tools and limited to fewer calls per minute: call it only when PnL is actually asked for.

limit.description: How many tokens, largest PnL first, to return (1-30, default 10).

name: get_wallet_pnl
title: Wallet trading profit and loss
